entities.name: Jalira
entities.description: A thief and polymorphist wielding blue smoke magic, with a warrant of execution, who studies physiology and travels with Yisan to plunder a sliver hive.

entities.name: Yisan
entities.description: An eyepatched bard who charms with music on his carapace lyre Tolumnus, and who stays behind to study the slivers' music.

entities.name: Dexros
entities.description: The commander of the guards of Lesh who tries to arrest Jalira and Yisan.

entities.name: Hastric
entities.description: A Thunian scout who studied the slivers and went mad, leaving a journal pointing to the hive and its treasure.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A drake summoner with aerial patrols whom Yisan and Jalira avoid after cheating him.

entities.name: Grendub
entities.description: A contact in Martyne who Jalira says can front most of the treasure's value.

entities.name: Tolumnus
entities.description: Yisan's lyre made of insectoid chitin.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Rapidly evolving hive creatures of the Kalonian Wilds who share a constant hum and obey a hivelord.

entities.name: Sliver Hivelord
entities.description: A massive sliver twenty times the size of a man that is the source and liege of the slivers, and who lets the pair take its hoarded treasure.

entities.name: Skep
entities.description: Creatures that the rambling Thunian scout begs people to be warned about, which Yisan boasts of killing.

entities.name: Lesh
entities.description: A corrupt, merchant-ruled city on a vital trade river on Shandalar, home to cults and agents of vampires.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Kalonian Wilds
entities.description: A dense forest region of Shandalar full of feral beasts, where the sliver hive lies.

entities.name: Martyne
entities.description: A town where Jalira intends to sell the treasure.

entities.name: Thune
entities.description: A far-off land whose soldier's uniform Hastric wore.

events.summary: Jalira and Yisan, both trying to rob a rambling Thunian man warning of the skep, compete over their mark in the market of Lesh.
events.quote: The soothsayer, however, was so enamored by the coin that he failed to see his audience was in contention.

events.summary: Guard commander Dexros tries to arrest Jalira and Yisan; Yisan spooks the guards' horses with a hummed tune and Jalira turns the thrown guards into frogs, and they flee.
events.quote: The guards transformed into tiny blue frogs, their empty clothes falling around them.

events.summary: Outside the city, Yisan reads the stolen book, the journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, revealing a sliver hive with abandoned treasure; Jalira decides to go.
events.quote: But contained within the notes were reports of dead merchants and travelers in the deepest parts of the sliver network

events.summary: Yisan and Jalira journey through the Kalonian Forest, fending off corrupted beasts and avoiding Talrand's aerial patrols.
events.quote: Neither counted the drake summoner as a friend for a variety of differing reasons

events.summary: They find the sliver cave and Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on them.
events.quote: Blue smoke began to flow from Jalira's fingertips.

events.summary: Jalira and Yisan, transformed into slivers, fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum and will of the hivelord.
events.quote: They lose each other, forgetting who they are.

events.summary: They reach the central chamber where the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and, naked, take clothing and treasure while the hivelord does nothing.
events.quote: slowly procured as many coins and treasures as they and their pilfered clothes could carry

events.summary: Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
events.quote: I think I'm going to stay here for a while,

relations.note: Thieves and sometime partners who travel and rob together.
relations.quote: Yisan, the man with the eye patch, looked at each other and sighed.

relations.note: Dexros arrests Jalira and Yisan; Jalira has a warrant of execution.
Yisan wears and plays the lyre Tolumnus.
relations.quote: On his lyre, Tolumnus, he strummed the same tune he had been humming.

relations.note: The hive follows the will of the hivelord, its liege.
relations.quote: Hastric had mentioned it was the source of the slivers, their liege.
